steps.text: The Tower is waiting for an answer about its gift.
Learn how things work here: move, fight, use a skill, open your status window.
Cross the village. The gate is past the square, at the end of the road.
The Keeper is waiting at the gate. Pass his trial.
Gather five bundles of loose straw. The Remnants in the fields shed it.
Bring the straw to the Keeper's house.
Find what was left behind: a toy by the river, glasses on the school steps, a knife out in the fields.
Each belongs to a house on the row. Put them back where they were.
Bring a plate from each house on the row.
Lay the table with the Keeper. Every place, the head of the table too.
